key_insight: Carrier Dynamics by Pockels Imaging (CDPI) directly visualizes charge carrier motion inside operating semiconductor devices by mapping local electric fields in space and time.
engineering_relevance: This gives device engineers a non-invasive way to connect internal carrier transport mechanisms to measured current, improving diagnosis and optimization of solar cells and other optoelectronic devices.
method: Probe the local electric field using the electro-optic Pockels effect.
Image photogenerated electron clouds in real space with nanosecond timing.
Correlate carrier evolution with conduction and displacement currents.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports micrometre-scale spatial resolution and nanosecond temporal resolution, demonstrated in CdTe radiation detectors.
watch_item: Practical use depends on having a sufficiently strong electro-optic response, so implementation may be limited in materials or device stacks with weak signal.
paper_title: Direct Spatiotemporal Imaging of Charge Carrier Dynamics in Operative Semiconductor Devices
